symptoms: ECG: QRS > 100ms (seizure risk), QRS > 160ms (ventricular arrhythmia risk), terminal R wave in aVR > 3mm

management_steps.details: Sodium Bicarbonate 1-2 mmol/kg (1-2 ml/kg 8.4% or 2-4 ml/kg 4.2%) IV bolus q5min until QRS narrows and BP improves. Target blood pH 7.50 - 7.55.

warnings: AVOID Class 1a antiarrhythmics, Amiodarone, and antiepileptics that block sodium channels.
